readbackResolution.interpretation: Direct CPU readbacks of the measured color resource trigger a persistent resource-dependent slowdown at exactly the tenth readback. Fresh/old color-target alternation reverses it while retaining the same depth texture, shaders, draw order, and particle data. Matches the APU linear-layout heuristic in Mesa 26.2.3 source; no GPU register trace of the relocation was collected.

interpolatedDepth.formula: windowDepth = 0.5 * (interpolatedClipZ / interpolatedClipW) + 0.5; requires depth range [0,1]. Both clip values are ordinary perspective-correct varyings. The existing portal predicate then uses windowDepth * 0.5 exactly as before.

livePaired.scope: All scoped world-particle submissions; sky and other renderer programs unchanged. No V8 profiler, no native dump flags. Original and alternative programs share diagnostic uniform-forwarding and frame-plan audit wrappers.

setup.renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi phoenix ACO), OpenGL ES 3.2)

nativeCompiler.limitations: Asynchronously interleaved compiler logs; creation records do not identify every runtime-selected cached binary. Native precision capture is not substituted for clean timing captures.

coordinateComparison.interpretation: The faster reconstructed-coordinate predicate has a slightly larger native program with the same VGPR allocation/compiler maximum wave count and no scratch. The builtin Z input bit is absent. Neither exports fragment depth. This localizes the difference to the depth-input execution path without proving the exact hardware stall or depth rejection behavior.

limitations: The corrected CPU reads copy color to disposable RGBA8 targets; the timed resource is never CPU-mapped. Background reset and all verification copies/readbacks remain outside elapsed GPU queries.
Frozen comparisons use 206 dominant particles and one camera; corrected multi-stage run preserves a common baseline byte-for-byte across stages.

Live server activity remains a confound between live windows. Five paired/reordered windows and stable dominant draw counts constrain but do not eliminate it. GPU phase snapshots are rolling means, not averages over every measured frame.
No native invocation, bandwidth, occupancy, or stall counters were collected on GLES. Fragment-Z dependence is measured; it does not alone prove lost early depth testing.

Clip-depth reconstruction is algebraically equivalent, but floating-point interpolation/rounding can differ. Stationary image equality and the recorded precision proof do not cover all portal boundaries, clipping cases, depth ranges, or devices.
No production optimization or visual acceptance performed.
failedAttempts: Predicate source initially referenced material uniforms before declaration; compilation failed before measurement. The corrected probe moves their existing declarations before the helpers. No timings accepted from the failed attempt.
exploratoryReductionImageCaveat: The native duplicate-only reduction has two pixels different from the original in its no-portal/copy-no-portal/coordinate-kill ablations (maximum channel delta 233). Those deliberately remove portal restrictions and are timing diagnostics, not rendering-equivalence evidence. Corrected predicate, interpolation, and precision captures separately record zero changed pixels for their evaluated variants.

boundaryFollowup.disposition: Reject direct clip-depth-varying substitution: strict portal visibility decisions differ.
